notes.title: New Update for Tad: The Lost Explorer
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42471845/c45d805fa701d928ced2f9ead3e00cd9645c5f60.png[/img]
[h1] New update for Tad: The Lost Explorer [/h1]

Attention Tad fans! The faithful adventure based on the Tad: The Lost Explorer movie has a [b]new update[/b]:

[h3][b]New comics![/b][/h3]
The new update brings us a very exciting new feature.... [b]NEW COMICS![/b], the [b]comic vignettes[/b] present in the videogame have been updated with a [b]new and amazing style[/b], and that will surely get you to smile with its countless [b] references and hidden details[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42471845/44bee7a69e429bd924c49a615b16b684b83cc2eb.gif[/img]

Remember that in Tad: The Lost Explorer you will find a[b] adventure faithful to the movie[/b]. You will have to guide Tad's steps to [b]free his dear friends[/b] from the curse that affects them. The adventure stands out for its variety, the alternation of [b]open 3D scenarios[/b], which can be fully explored (Veracruz, Chicago, Paris, Egypt), and [b]2D platform levels[/b], in which the player's skill will be essential.
 
That is to say: scenarios to fall backwards, hours of excitement, platforms, combat, collecting, puzzles... We must also highlight the graphic section, very close to that of the film both in design and animations. 

[b]Featured content:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Narrative[/b] in the purest Tad Stone style.
[*] [b]Freedom[/b] to explore the [b]3D scenarios[/b], full of objects to collect and adventures.
[*] Action in the [b]2D levels[/b], to show your skill at the controls.
[*] Countless [b]references and surprises[/b].
[*] Funny [b]comic cinematics[/b].
[*] Already [b]available on [url=https://store.playstation.com/es-es/concept/10004674]PS4, PS5[/url] (also in physical format) and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1966690/Tadeo_Jones_La_Tabla_Esmeralda/?l=english]Steam[/url][/b].
[/list]
